title: Deep Equality
prompt: Write `deepEqual(a, b)`: primitives compare with Object.is; arrays compare element-wise (same order); objects compare by having exactly the same keys with deeply equal values; null compares only to null. Arrays are not equal to objects.

tests.name: primitives and null
tests.hint: Object.is first; if both are non-null objects, recurse.

tests.name: structures compare structurally
tests.hint: Array.isArray check before the object branch; compare Object.keys lengths, then each key recursively.
